spans.text:
def nc_constructor_value(+name: String, +ws: List<&2, String>, +n: U32) -> N_Emitted:
  nt_choose(N_Emitted, p88_string_eq(name, "Zero") || p88_string_eq(name, "False"), u => N_Emitted{"", "0", n}, u =>
  nt_choose(N_Emitted, p88_string_eq(name, "True"), u => N_Emitted{"", "1", n}, u =>
  nt_choose(N_Emitted, p88_string_eq(name, "Succ"), u => N_Emitted{"", "nat_chk(e, " ++ nc_head(ws) ++ " + 1)", n}, u =>
  nt_choose(N_Emitted, p88_string_eq(name, "U32") || p88_string_eq(name, "F32"), u => N_Emitted{"", "term_word(e, " ++ nc_head(ws) ++ ")", n}, u =>
  nt_choose(N_Emitted, p88_string_eq(name, "Chr"), u => N_Emitted{"", nc_head(ws), n}, u =>
  nt_choose(N_Emitted, p88_string_eq(name, "ALeaf"), u => N_Emitted{"Term init[1] = { " ++ nc_head(ws) ++ " };\n", "blk_new(e, !NATIVE_SCALAR_ARRAYS, 0, 0, 1, init)", n}, u =>
  nt_choose(N_Emitted, p88_string_eq(name, "ANode"), u => N_Emitted{"", "blk_node(e, " ++ nc_head(ws) ++ ", " ++ nc_head(nc_tail(ws)) ++ ")", n}, u =>
    ne_constructor(name, ws, False{}, n, True{}))))))))

spans.name: nc_field_word
spans.text:
def nc_field_word(+name: String, +word: String, +i: U32) -> String:
  nt_choose(String, p88_string_eq(name, "Succ"), u => "(" ++ word ++ " - 1)", u =>
  nt_choose(String, p88_string_eq(name, "Chr"), u => word, u =>
  nt_choose(String, p88_string_eq(name, "U32") || p88_string_eq(name, "F32"), u => "native_word(e, (u32)" ++ word ++ ")", u =>
  nt_choose(String, p88_string_eq(name, "ALeaf"), u => "blk_leaf(e, " ++ word ++ ")", u =>
  nt_choose(String, p88_string_eq(name, "ANode"), u => "blk_half(e, " ++ word ++ ", " ++ U32.show(i) ++ ")", u =>
    "e.mem[term_peek(e, " ++ word ++ ") + " ++ U32.show(i) ++ "]")))))

spans.name: ns_static_scalar_fields
spans.text:
def ns_static_scalar_fields(+t: KTerm, fields: List<&2, KTerm>) -> KTerm:
  match fields:
    case Nil{}:
      nt_choose(KTerm, p88_string_eq(nm(t), "True") || p88_string_eq(nm(t), "False"),
        u => kt("NWord", nt_choose(String, p88_string_eq(nm(t), "True"), v => "1", v => "0"), 0, 0, Nil{}), u => t)
    case Con{+h, Nil{}}:
      nt_choose(KTerm, p88_string_eq(nm(t), "Chr") && p98_tag_eq(h, "NWord"), u => h, u => t)
    case _: t

def nh_field_test(+ctor: String, +i: U32) -> String:
  "!DEVICE && NATIVE_FIELD32_" ++ nt_cid(ctor) ++ "_" ++ U32.show(i)

spans.name: nh_cast_words
spans.text:
def nh_cast_words(+ctor: String, words: List<&2, String>, +i: U32) -> String:
  match words:
    case Nil{}: ""
    case Con{+word, rest}: "#if " ++ nh_field_test(ctor, i) ++ "\n" ++ word ++ " = (u32)" ++ word ++ ";\n#endif\n" ++ nh_cast_words(ctor, rest, U32.inc(i))

def nh_field_macros(+book: List<&2, KDef>, ds: List<&2, KDef>) -> String:
  match ds:
    case Nil{}: ""
    case Con{+d, rest}:
      nt_choose(String, p88_string_eq(dk(d), "ADT") && Bool.not(db(d)) && U32.is_eq(da(d), 0) && U32.is_eq(dx(d), 0), u => nh_field_ctors(book, dc(d)), u => "") ++ nh_field_macros(book, rest)

spans.name: ne_stores
spans.text:
def ne_stores(+base: String, +ws: List<&2, String>, +i: U32, +seal: Bool) -> String:
  match ws:
    case Nil{}: ""
    case Con{+h, +t}: "e.mem[" ++ base ++ " + " ++ U32.show(i) ++ "] = " ++ nt_choose(String, seal, u => "rfc_seal(e, " ++ h ++ ")", u => h) ++ ";\n" ++ ne_stores(base, t, U32.inc(i), seal)

spans.name: ne_ctor_node
spans.text:
def ne_ctor_node(+k: String, +alloc: String, +ws: List<&2, String>, +n: U32, +hot: Bool) -> N_Emitted:
  +name = nt_local("nd", n)
  +stores = nt_choose(String, hot && String.starts_with(k, "$ctor."),
    u => "#if NATIVE_COLD_USER_CTORS
" ++ ne_stores(name, ws, 0, False{}) ++ "#else
" ++ ne_stores(name, ws, 0, True{}) ++ "#endif
",
    u => ne_stores(name, ws, 0, hot))
  N_Emitted{"u64 " ++ name ++ " = " ++ alloc ++ ";
#if !DEVICE && NATIVE_COLD_CTORS && !NATIVE_HOT_" ++ nt_cid(k) ++ "
" ++ ne_stores(name, ws, 0, False{}) ++ "#else
" ++ stores ++ "#endif
", name, U32.inc(n)}

spans.name: Char.to_u32
spans.text:
def Char.to_u32(c: Char) -> U32:
  match c:
    case Chr{x}:
      x

spans.name: io_str
rfc_seal
io_node

findings: Trusted Base Char is Chr(U32); native constructor and projection are identity on that complete unsigned word.
Only literal CID_SCON runtime constructor site is io_str; UTF-8 decoder stores the raw codepoint at field0 and seals only the tail.
Provider files contain no direct CID_SCON construction; args.c and file_read.c call io_str.
General generated constructors store/seal the existing field word; a valid 32-bit scalar has no constructor/reference tag and rfc_seal returns it unchanged.
Changing only NATIVE_FIELD32_CID_SCON_0 affects existing !DEVICE declarations/casts; field1 must remain full Term.
limitations: Static correspondence, not a whole-compiler representation theorem.
Requires checked trusted Base identity, canonical intrinsic lowering, authenticated runtime/providers and retained raw/device fallback.
Arbitrary raw KDef books or forged foreign heap cells are outside the admitted contract.
